en.headline: Two suspected wartime bombs found at Sham Shui Po sports ground site
en.dek: Police said two small suspected wartime bombs about 5 centimetres long were found at a construction site in Sham Shui Po Sports Ground on Friday evening and removed after checks found no danger.
body: Police received a report around 6pm on Friday that two suspected wartime bombs had been found at a construction site inside Sham Shui Po Sports Ground.
The items measured about 5 centimetres in length and 2 centimetres in diameter. Explosive Ordnance Disposal personnel attended the scene, cordoned off a 15-metre radius and examined the objects.
After inspection, officers assessed that the items posed no danger and removed them for disposal. No injuries were reported.

The same site near the sports ground had yielded a World War II-era British mortar shell about 24 centimetres long on 20 November. That shell was also found to contain no residual explosive and was safely destroyed.
Authorities reminded the public to report any suspicious objects found during construction or excavation work and not to handle them.

zh.headline: 深水埗運動場地盤發現兩枚懷疑戰時炸彈
zh.dek: 警方表示周五傍晚深水埗運動場內地盤發現兩枚約5厘米長的懷疑戰時炸彈，爆炸品處理人員檢查後認為無危險並已帶走。
body: 警方周五傍晚約6時接獲報案，指深水埗運動場內一個地盤發現兩枚懷疑戰時炸彈。
該兩枚物件長約5厘米、直徑約2厘米。爆炸品處理課人員到場，封鎖現場約15米範圍並進行檢查。
經檢查後，人員相信物件沒有危險，已將其帶走處理。事件中無人受傷。
同一帶地盤於11月20日亦曾發現一枚二戰時期英式迫擊砲彈，長約24厘米，檢查後確認內無殘餘炸藥並已安全銷毀。
當局提醒市民如在工程或挖掘期間發現可疑物品，應立即報警，切勿自行處理。
